touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small rural locality south of Banchory with limited independent visitor depth.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Local outdoor access may support a dog walk, with close control around roads, livestock and wildlife.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality pending any full destination audit
townGuide.intro: Scolty Hill and Banchory remain separate visitor propositions. Their appeal does not promote Auchattie as a destination.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Ordnance Survey Open Names centre and Aberdeenshire Council Auchattie Road evidence with a conservative editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Auchattie has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.
